notes.title: Rest Developer Q&A and Live Demo Play-through (20:00 GMT+2)
notes.content:
A Rest Team Demo live-stream schedule: 

[b]Timezone GMT+2[/b]

[b]20:00 :[/b] Kickoff and Team introduction 

[b]20:30 - 21:00 :[/b] Play-through of Demo

[b]21:00 :[/b] Production talk + Q&A

Join the Rest team as we showcase our demo live, talk about the development and answer your questions. 

We will be playing through the entirety of our demo, available now for download, while giving developer commentary!
